personal_info.professional_summary: Biomedical engineer currently pursuing a master's degree, passionate about technology, medicine, and serving others. My career has been marked by a constant pursuit of personal and professional growth, leading me to explore opportunities in various states of Mexico, both in the academic and professional spheres. I have a solid background in developing technological solutions applied to health and wellness, combining my skills in biomedical engineering with data analysis and artificial intelligence to address complex problems in the medical sector. My focus is on innovation and process improvement that positively impacts people's quality of life.
